info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Payments Payments Capture-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Capture API facilitates the processing and capture of customer payments within the system. This endpoint allows businesses to confirm and finalize payment transactions after initial authorization, ensuring that funds are successfully transferred. It is typically used by e-commerce platforms, financial institutions, and payment processors who need a reliable method for managing finalized transactions. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their payment workflows and improve customer satisfaction through timely transaction handling.

post.description: Initiates the capture of a previously authorized payment transaction. This process marks the transaction as finalized and ensures that the funds are transferred from the customer's account to the merchant's account.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a payment capture operation. It should contain the necessary information required for processing the payment capture.

200.description: The payment capture was successful and the transaction is completed.

requestId.description: The unique identifier for this request.

referenceNumber.description: An external reference number associated with the payment.

customer.description: Information about the customer making the payment.

priority.description: The priority level of the payment request.

amount.description: The amount of money to be captured.

currency.description: The currency in which the payment is made.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the request was made.
